summary: Respan's Span-01 Lite is a behavior-scoring model released 2026-09-26: for each plain-language behavior you define it returns the probability the behavior is present in a conversation span, suited to high-volume evaluation and monitoring. The respan/span-01-lite:free endpoint is $0 and rate-limited. It runs at https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions, not chat completions. The OpenRouter SDK requires serverURL https://openrouter.ai for this path. Follow the Respan-specific state schema rather than copying Jev examples unchanged.
claim_steps: Create an OpenRouter account and API key at openrouter.ai/settings/keys.

POST model respan/span-01-lite:free to https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions, not chat completions. For the OpenRouter SDK, set serverURL to https://openrouter.ai before alpha.decisions.create; follow the model-specific state schema.
Free endpoint is rate-limited; pricing shows $0 for prompt and completion tokens.
